remarks: Newly finished first floor privates offices available starting at $500/m. A great location near downtown Byram, a Brooklyn-Like area of Greenwich, CT. Easy access to I-95 and the metro north train station into NYC. The building is located on the quiet side street of Oak St West with on-site parking right in front of the main entrance. A welcoming entrance with Robbin Blue door welcomes you a pristine hallway. On your right, three varying sized sun filled offices. To your left, a reception (possible 5th office), another private office, bathroom, and kitchenette. Private Offices Available; Office 1 - $1,000/m, Office 2 - $1,250/m, Office 3 - $1,000/m, Office 4 - $500/m, Office 5 - $1,250/m, Entire Space - $3700/m.
